svg.title: Split Crown routes and carrier neighborhoods
svg.desc: Measured plan and elevation of the implemented Split Crown arena, with four helical routes and one long carrier transfer. Dashed six-metre neighborhoods cover local route pairs and the carrier, but do not bridge the districts.
svg.text: Split Crown · five routes, one defense
Four regular gates unfold in stages. The final carrier visits both existing defense neighborhoods.
Measured geometry from the arena source · all routes terminate at the existing core · no weapon range or flight-bound expansion
Dashed circles: example 6m-radius neighborhoods, shown at the same scale in both views. Projection alone does not establish contact.
One local field can help three routes when the carrier arrives.
West neighborhood: A 12.4m + B 10.8m + E 12.0m of route inside the 6m sphere.
East neighborhood: C 12.4m + D 10.8m + E 12.0m. Neither neighborhood reaches the other district.
Carrier: 486 hull · ordinary cumulative damage · 40 core on breach · 41.6 seconds unimpeded route travel
Normal starting scrap and 8-slot fleet · unlimited setup · selected-drone repositioning · no required Stasis placement
Lengths use actual sampled paths; neighborhood coverage uses nominal route centers at 0.2m spacing. Wisps drift. Geometry is not a claim of human difficulty.
